description:
ConnectMachine is a digital business-card and contact platform. This plugin lets you work with your ConnectMachine network in natural language.

Contacts: create, find, update, and delete contacts; smart search across name, company, job title, email, phone, notes, location, and the event where you met. When two contacts share a name, the plugin reports the ambiguity and asks which one you mean instead of guessing.

Events: track which event you met a contact at, and organize contacts into networks (labels).

Digital cards: create and edit your business cards, including websites and social links, or extract contact data from a card photo.

Housekeeping: detect and merge duplicate contacts, see where your contacts came from, and bulk-import leads.

You sign in with your existing ConnectMachine account. Data stays in ConnectMachine; the plugin only returns what is needed to answer each request. Included with ConnectMachine accounts; a few advanced actions (CSV export, industry and location filters) follow the same Premium rules as the app and reply with a clear upgrade message on free accounts.

defaultPrompt: Show me everyone I met at Web Summit last year and draft a follow-up note for each.
Add Jane Doe from Acme as a new contact with her email jane@acme.com
Find duplicate contacts in my CRM and merge the obvious ones.
